prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side in the aisle of a passenger airplane cabin with rows of grey seats on both sides, overhead luggage bins, small oval windows, cool white cabin lighting, a grey carpeted floor. Behind them, several ordinary passengers sitting in the seats and standing in the aisle are softly out of focus, their figures and faces blurred by shallow depth of field into gentle shapes and colours, while the women stay razor sharp in the foreground, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, the cool white light of the cabin raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a soft, neutral expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes. Long almond nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in French Limoges enamel — a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense grisaille scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's condition: A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet.

Left woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the floor beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Right woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a calm, distant gaze, deep dark brown hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real living eyes. Long oval nails, holographic finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay — a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay, wide gold-and-silver bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star inlay filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's condition: A small smudge of soot touches her temple and jaw, with light grime on her fingers and the tops of her bare feet.

Right woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the floor beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Right woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Right woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Composition: the whole row of women fills the width of the tall frame, each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 vertical portrait 8K, taller than it is wide.
